comment: Thresholds for the descriptive tags (docs/plans/patch-library.md, Descriptive tags), applied by analyze.py to the middle note's measurements (note 60) unless noted. Set on 2026-11-24 from the spread over all 21,817 patches, so that each tag picks out a distinct minority (brightness is the magnitude-weighted spectral centroid). Rerun 'analyze.py --tags-only' then index.py after changing them.
